title: Visual Policy Simulator
description: Form-based: pick capabilities, add risk tags, add metadata. Hit "Test." Matching rule card glows. Evaluation waterfall shows skip/skip/MATCH. Replay mode: re-evaluate last N real jobs against draft policy, show impact diff.
definitionOfDone: Simulator panel/page with form inputs: capabilities (dropdown), risk tags (dropdown), metadata key-values
Evaluation waterfall: shows each rule with skip/MATCH status
Replay mode: fetch last N real jobs, re-evaluate against draft
Impact diff: N jobs allowed → now denied, N → now require approval

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/policy/PolicySimulator.tsx: Simulator panel. Form section: capabilities multi-select dropdown, risk tags multi-select dropdown, metadata key-value pairs (add/remove rows with Input components). 'Test' button calls useSimulatePolicy() mutation with form data. Results section: evaluation waterfall — ordered list of all rules showing 'skip' (muted) or 'MATCH' (highlighted, glowing border with decision color). The matched rule card gets an animated glow effect (CSS animation). Shows: matched rule ID, decision, reason, eval time.
implementationPlan.note: Created PolicySimulator with tag inputs for capabilities/risk tags, metadata key-value editor, Test button calling useSimulatePolicy(), result summary card, and evaluation waterfall with matched rule glow effects.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/policy/PolicyReplay.tsx: Replay mode panel within simulator. 'Replay' button fetches last N real jobs (configurable: 10, 50, 100). Re-evaluates each against the current draft policy rules. Shows impact diff table: columns (job ID, original decision, new decision, changed badge). Summary at top: 'N jobs would change: X allowed→denied, Y denied→allowed, Z now require approval'. Color-coded change indicators.
implementationPlan.note: Created PolicyReplay with configurable job count (10/50/100), batch simulate against draft, impact summary card, and diff table with original vs new decision and change arrows.
